```{r setup}
#| include: false

# load knitr 
library(knitr)

# set knitr chunk options 
opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,
                message = FALSE,
                warning = FALSE)
```

## Load Packages

```{r packages}

# load packages
library(openxlsx)
```

## Scramble Population 

```{r}

# read population file into data frame
population <- read.xlsx("../../sampling/population.xlsx")

# set seed to get the same random split each time running the script
set.seed(42)

# randomly reorder rows of dataframe
pop_scrambled <- population[sample(1:nrow(population)),]

```

## Export dataframe

```{r}

# write scrambled population in a new file
write.xlsx(pop_scrambled, file = "population_scrambled.xlsx")

```
